description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Chameleon.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Chameleon by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.name: Chameleon, Master of Disguise
uses.cardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater
